newsitem.title: USA: Goldman Sachs posts record first-half profit.
newsitem.headline: Goldman Sachs posts record first-half profit.

text.p: Goldman Sachs & Co said Wednesday that pre-tax earnings for the first half of its fiscal year were a record $1.52 billion, up 19 percent from the $1.27 billion it earned in the same period last year reflecting strong performances across the company's business lines.

In a statement outlining results for the quarter, Goldman Chief Financial Officer John Thain said the privately-held investment bank's revenues for the six-month period totalled $3.63 billion, up from $3.13 billion a year ago. Expenses climbed to $2.12 billion from $1.86 billion.
